understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in every level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won, while avoiding spikes.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removes an indicated breakable block when targeting its coordinates and does not advance the rising-platform timer; landing on spike tiles ends the attempt. Each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns, and UNDO reverts the previous action. Corridor and landing previews should be used to find safe passage columns and avoid hazards.
